title: Tech Note: 4D Portal: The Auctions portlet

historical_commentary.text: 4D Portal as a product is long discontinued, making the specific Auctions portlet implementation obsolete for current development; modern auction-style web features would be built with contemporary web frameworks and session management approaches rather than this legacy platform.
related_updates: 4D Portal has been discontinued; modern web applications would implement equivalent auction/portlet-style features using current web frameworks
